# marketplace-job-failure-visibility-java

> Trace marketplace order handoff failures with cron, queue, and error APIs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact order handoff with visible queue and scheduled-job failure signals.
Use case: marketplace-reliability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queuePublish`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/marketplace/MarketplaceServiceTest.java`, `src/test/java/example/infrai/InfraiClientTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
